ApiHeader.description:
A block header as the API presents it: with its id, and without the
fields only consensus needs.

ApiMantleTx.description: A transaction as the API presents it: its ops, with the transaction hash.

ApiProcessedBlockEvent.description:
API response type for processed block events.
Includes the full block along with the current chain state (tip and LIB).

Note: The first event after subscribing may be an initial snapshot of the
current state. In this case, `block.header.id` can equal `tip` and does not
represent a newly processed block. Clients should handle events
idempotently.

lib.description: The current Last Irreversible Block after processing this block.

tip.description: The current canonical tip after processing this block.

ApiSignedHeader.description: The signed header of an uncle a block references.

AutoClaimStatus.description: The runtime state of unattended claiming.

BlockFilter.description: Filter for block types in the `get_blocks_range_stream` method.

BlockSortOrder.description: Sort order for blocks in the `get_blocks_range_stream` method.

BuildVersionInfo.description: Version and build provenance of a running node.

commit.description:
Abbreviated commit the binary was built from, absent when it was not
built from a git checkout.

profile.description: Cargo profile the binary was compiled with.

rustc.description: Version of the compiler that built the binary.

tag.description: Tag pointing exactly at that commit, absent when there is none.

target.description: Target triple the binary was compiled for.

version.description: Crate version of the binary, e.g. `0.3.0-rc.2`.

ChainIdResponseBody.description:
The chain this node runs on.

The chain ID is fixed by the node's deployment settings, so this body is
constant for the lifetime of the process.

signatures.description: Ordered by strictly increasing `channel_key_index`; other orderings are rejected.

ClaimPowRewardOp.description:
Operation claiming the `PoW` reward for a solved puzzle.

The puzzle solution is not carried directly on the op: it is proven by
deriving a [`PuzzleTicket`] from `epoch_nonce`, `block_hash` and
`public_key` (see [`Self::get_puzzle_ticket`]) and checking that ticket
against the current reward difficulty during validation.

block_hash.description: 32-byte hash, serialized as an array of 32 byte values (not as a hex string).

epoch_nonce.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

public_key.description: Public key of the reward beneficiary.

ClaimTargetStatus.description: One auto-claim target alongside its current balance.

ClaimableRewardsInfo.description: A summary of the rewards this node can currently claim.

claimable_tickets.description: Number of mined tickets still within the reward window.

slots_until_expiry.description:
For each claimable ticket, how many more slots it stays within the
reward window before it can no longer be claimed.

DepositNote.description:
A single channel note a deposit re-created from one of its inputs.

Carries the data a wallet needs to track and later select the note: its id,
value, and owning public key. The public key is the depositor's — a deposit
re-creates each input note unchanged inside the channel — so a withdrawal
client can tell which key must authorize spending it.

metadata.description: Deposit metadata: arbitrary bytes, serialized as an array of byte values (not as a hex string).

addr.description: Multiaddress of the peer to dial.

Ed25519PublicKey.description: Ed25519 public key: 32-byte compressed Edwards point, hex encoded. Must decode to a valid curve point that is not of small order.

filters.description: Level per tracing target. The `*` key sets the default level.

ErrorBody.description:
Body returned for every API error response, mirroring the
`{code, message}` envelope used by the Ethereum Beacon API.

Event.description: An event generated by the execution of block/transaction/operation

oneOf.description: Emitted while processing a block header

Header.description: Emitted while processing a block header

Events.description: Events generated by the execution of block/transaction/operation

GasPricesResponseBody.description: Current gas prices from the ledger state at the given tip.

proof.description: Compressed Groth16 proof: 128 bytes, hex encoded.

entropy_contribution.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

proof.description: Compressed Groth16 proof: 128 bytes, hex encoded.

HeaderEvent.description: Events emitted while processing a block header

oneOf.description:
A service note has been unlocked because the epoch after its
declaration's `withdraw_at` has been reached.

SdpNoteUnlocked.description:
A service note has been unlocked because the epoch after its
declaration's `withdraw_at` has been reached.

oneOf.description: A reward UTXO was minted to a provider.

SdpRewardDistributed.description: A reward UTXO was minted to a provider.

inscription.description: Inscription payload: arbitrary bytes, hex encoded (serialized unprefixed).

parent.description: Enforce that this inscription comes after this tx

LeaderAgedNoteResponseBody.description:
One wallet-owned UTXO old enough to take part in the leadership
lottery.

public_key.description: The wallet address holding the note.

LeaderAgedNotesResponseBody.description:
The wallet's UTXOs that are eligible to lead at `tip`.

A note is eligible when it is present in the epoch's aged UTXO
snapshot — the same stake distribution the leadership proof is built
against — and its public key is one the wallet holds a key for. An
empty `notes` means this node cannot win a slot at `tip`: either it
owns no notes, or none of them have aged into the current epoch's
snapshot yet.

The set is reported unfiltered. The leader service additionally skips
the faucet UTXO when a `faucet_pk` is configured, which only matters on
a faucet node.

count.description:
Number of eligible notes. `notes.len()`, repeated so a caller can
answer "am I eligible?" without walking the list.

LogLevel.description:
A tracing verbosity level. Matched case-insensitively; `1` (error) to
`5` (trace) are accepted as well.

MantleTxBuilder.description: A partially built transaction, e.g. one to be funded by a wallet.

channel_multi_sig_proofs.description: Channel multi-signature proofs keyed by the (decimal) index of the operation in `mantle_tx.ops` they authorize.

ledger_inputs.description: The notes spent by `pending_transfer`, matching its inputs one to one.

Op.description: A Mantle operation, tagged by its `opcode`, with the operation itself as its `payload`.

OpProof.description: The proof authorizing the operation at the same index. Which variant is required is determined by that operation.

OpProofs.description: One proof per operation, at the index of the operation it authorizes.

Ops.description: The operations of a transaction, in order.

PoWClaimRequestBody.description:
Where a claim request pays the rewards.

The whole body is optional, and so is the key inside it: both omitted mean
"use the node's auto-claim target".

PoWClaimResponseBody.description:
The id of the reward-claim transaction submitted by a claim request, or
`null` when there were no rewards to claim.

PoWStatus.description: The runtime state of the `PoW` service, as the running service holds it.

PowNullifier.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

key_nullifier.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

proof.description: Compressed Groth16 proof. Unlike other proofs, its points are serialized as arrays of byte values, not as hex strings.

selection_randomness.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

RewardsRoot.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

SignedOps.description: Signed Mantle transaction: the unsigned transaction, plus one proof per operation. `ops_proofs` must be as long as `mantle_tx.ops`.

TxEvent.description: An event emitted while processing a transaction

op_id.description: 32-byte hash, serialized as an array of 32 byte values (not as a hex string).

TxEventPayload.description: Event payloads emitted while processing a transaction

metadata.description: Deposit metadata: arbitrary bytes, serialized as an array of byte values (not as a hex string).

notes.description:
The channel notes the deposit re-created its inputs as. They carry
new `NoteId`s, so a channel cannot derive them from the payload.

oneOf.description: A leader claim operation created the reward note for its beneficiary.

LeaderRewardClaimed.description: A leader claim operation created the reward note for its beneficiary.

oneOf.description: A `PoW` claim operation created a reward note for its beneficiary

PoWRewardClaimed.description: A `PoW` claim operation created a reward note for its beneficiary

UnverifiedEd25519PublicKey.description: Ed25519 public key: 32-byte compressed Edwards point, hex encoded. Must decode to a valid curve point; small-order points are accepted.

op_id.description: 32-byte hash, serialized as an array of 32 byte values (not as a hex string).

VoucherCm.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

VoucherNullifier.description: BN254 scalar field element: 32 bytes, little-endian, hex encoded. The value must be below the field modulus.

reward_amount.description:
What a single voucher pays out at `tip`.

The reward pool is split evenly across every unclaimed voucher on
the chain, so this is the same for each entry in `vouchers` and it
moves as other leaders claim. It is a snapshot at `tip`, not a
guarantee of what a claim submitted now will settle for.

total_claimable.description:
`reward_amount` times the number of `vouchers`: what this wallet
could claim in total at `tip`.

max_tx_fee.description: Absolute hard cap on the final funded transaction fee.

priority_fee_percent.description:
Percentage of the final mandatory fee reserved as a priority fee.
The percentage applies to the complete mandatory fee (execution
plus storage), not to storage alone. Only the unused reserve is an
effective priority tip. The default used by the Zone SDK and TUI
is 12%, a practical reserve intended to absorb normal fee movement,
including approximately one storage-market epoch increase at
normal price levels. It is not a protocol guarantee at very low
prices or when execution fees also rise materially. Storage prices
use integer arithmetic, so a low price can jump proportionally more
(for example, 1 to 2). `0` funds exactly to the mandatory fee; the
value is not capped at 100.

funded_tx.description:
The funded transaction, with the fee transfer appended as the last
op. All ops are still unsigned.

tip.description: Tip the transaction was funded against.

oneOf.description:
Proof for the appended fee transfer, signed over the funded
transaction hash. `None` if funding required no transfer (zero
fee and no inputs pulled in).

ZkSignature.description: ZkSign signature: a compressed Groth16 proof over BN254.

pi_a.description: 32-byte compressed curve point. Serialized as unprefixed hex; an array of 32 byte values is also accepted on input.

pi_b.description: 64-byte compressed curve point. Serialized as unprefixed hex; an array of 64 byte values is also accepted on input.

pi_c.description: 32-byte compressed curve point. Serialized as unprefixed hex; an array of 32 byte values is also accepted on input.

get.description: Streams blocks of the canonical chain in a slot range, optionally restricted to immutable blocks. The stream ends when the range or `blocks_limit` is exhausted.

parameters.description:
If omitted, the server chooses a default lower bound.
For descending streams this is `slot 0` (bounded by `blocks_limit`).
For ascending streams, `slot_from` is estimated from the average
slots-per-block and `blocks_limit`, biased so the stream ends near
`slot_to`. This may return fewer than `blocks_limit` blocks; callers
can refine by specifying `slot_from` explicitly.
parameters.name: slot_from

parameters.description:
Upper bound slot (inclusive). Defaults to tip slot, or LIB slot when
`immutable_only=true`.
parameters.name: slot_to

parameters.description:
The maximum number of actual blocks to return. If omitted:
- explicit bounded slot range (`slot_from` and `slot_to`) defaults to
  the server maximum (`630_720_000`);
- otherwise defaults to `100`.
parameters.name: blocks_limit

parameters.description:
